responses.draft_cover_letter:
I have built automated test suites in Python using pytest, creating both functional and contract tests that verify API behavior. In my recent role I designed and maintained GitHub Actions pipelines that run these pytest suites on every commit, ensuring rapid feedback and reliable releases.

My work focused on integrating contract testing directly into the CI workflow, so that any change breaking the API contract is caught early. This experience aligns closely with the core responsibilities of the QA Automation Engineer position at Ripple Retail, where Python‑based testing and CI integration are essential.

While my background does not yet include Playwright or Selenium, I am keen to apply my strong Python testing foundation to browser automation and quickly become productive with those tools. Likewise, I am interested in expanding into performance testing with k6 or Locust and would welcome the opportunity to develop those skills on your team.

I am excited about contributing to Ripple Retail’s quality initiatives, leveraging my pytest and CI expertise, and growing into the broader automation stack you employ. Thank you for considering my application.
